keyword.en: electric 10 concrete pump no vertical distance
keyword.zh: 电动10为什么没有垂直距离

title.en: Why Electric 10 Has No Vertical Distance Cell
title.zh: 电动10为什么没有垂直距离格

description.en: Electric 10 prints 25 m horizontal and does not print a vertical line. Neighbouring compact pumps do not fill that blank.
description.zh: 电动10印水平 25 m，没有印垂直行。相邻的紧凑泵不能填这个空白。

h1.en: Why Electric 10 Has No Vertical Distance Cell
h1.zh: 电动10为什么没有垂直距离格

directAnswer.en: The Electric 10 Series concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints horizontal pumping distance as 25 m and does not print a vertical delivery cell. It does print 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, a 0.1 m³ hopper and aggregate 2 cm and below. Electric 15's vertical range of 15–20 m is not an Electric 10 figure. B500S-83D's 5 m vertical is not either. A missing line stays missing.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的电动10系列混凝土泵把水平输送距离印成 25 m，没有印垂直输送格。它印了 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³ 和骨料 2 cm 及以下。电动15的垂直范围 15–20 m 不是电动10的数字。B500S-83D 的垂直 5 m 也不是。缺的一行就保持缺失。

body.en: The label is horizontal pumping distance. The value is 25 m. There is no second number hiding in that cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not write 25 m / something.
body.zh: 标题是水平输送距离。数值是 25 m。这一格里没有藏着第二个数字。河北品锦机械没有写成 25 m / 某个数。

heading.en: High output does not create a height

body.en: 21 m³/h is higher than Electric 20's 8–10 m³/h, yet Electric 20 is the page that prints a vertical figure, 40 m, inside 120 m / 40 m. Output and vertical distance are different columns.
body.zh: 21 m³/h 高于电动20的 8–10 m³/h，但印出垂直数字的是电动20，在 120 m / 40 m 里垂直是 40 m。产量和垂直距离是不同的列。

heading.en: How to ask for a height

body.en: If a job needs a vertical figure, do not borrow one. Use /en/contact/ and name Electric 10 Series. The factory is in Xingtai.
body.zh: 如果工况需要垂直数字，不要借用。请用 /zh/contact/ 并写明电动10系列。工厂在邢台。

question.zh: 印出的水平距离是多少？

question.en: Is there a vertical metre on the page?

answer.en: No vertical delivery cell is printed.

question.zh: 可以用电动15的 15–20 m 吗？

answer.en: No. That range is printed on Electric 15 only.
answer.zh: 不能。那个范围只印在电动15上。

answer.en: 0.1 m³, the smallest hopper volume printed on these concrete pump sheets.
answer.zh: 0.1 m³，是这些混凝土泵参数页里印出的最小料斗容积。
